module mg_10593(CLK,RST,CLKOUT,CLKOUTn);
input CLK; 
  input RST; 
  output CLKOUT; 
  output CLKOUTn; 
  reg CLKOUT = 1'b1; 
  parameter cntEndVal = 19'h493E0; 
  reg [18:0] clkCount = 19'h00000; 
  assign CLKOUTn = ~CLKOUT; 
  always @(posedge CLK) begin 
  if(RST == 1'b1) begin 
  CLKOUT <= 1'b0; 
  clkCount <= 0; 
  end 
  else begin 
  if(clkCount == cntEndVal) begin 
  CLKOUT <= ~CLKOUT; 
  clkCount <= 0; 
  end 
  else begin 
  clkCount <= clkCount + 1'b1; 
  end 
  end 
  end 
 endmodule
